items.question: What is Tasmeemai?
items.answer: Tasmeemai is a short-form content creation and publishing platform for MENA. It turns trends and brand ideas into videos and slides placed on a calendar for review and publishing.

items.question: What content can I create?
items.answer: Tasmeemai focuses on short videos, slideshow posts, product content, faceless content, and the scripts and captions that go with them.

items.question: Can it fill my content calendar automatically?
items.answer: That is the core of the product: build a recurring content plan from your product and market, then review and edit each piece before scheduling or publishing.

items.question: Is the product available outside MENA?
items.answer: The product is currently focused exclusively on the Middle East and North Africa so we can build a deeper experience for regional content teams.

items.question: Can I publish directly to my accounts?
items.answer: Yes. The publishing workflow focuses on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, subject to each platform's policies and permissions.

items.question: Do you sell TikTok or Instagram accounts?
items.answer: No. Tasmeemai does not sell accounts or operate fake identities. You connect the brand accounts that you own and control.

items.question: Can I use the interface in English?
items.answer: Yes. Arabic is the default, and you can switch to English from the language control at any time.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: It is currently free to start during early access. Any future plan changes will be communicated clearly before they take effect.
